title: ModelPrice
description:
Per-model price row (admin pricing API and `/v1/models` display).

Amounts are integer micro-units; `*_multiplier_bps` are basis points (10_000 = 1.0x) for peak/off-peak billing (`docs/22` §4). Mirrors the wire shape currently emitted by `srv.pricing` (T22 contract-first follow-up).

cached_per_1k_micros.description: Cached-input price per 1K tokens in micro-units.

input_per_1k_micros.description: Input price per 1K tokens in micro-units.

output_per_1k_micros.description: Output price per 1K tokens in micro-units.
